title: Who Does What?
purpose: Teach primary ownership versus cross-functional collaboration.

cases.problem: Supplier requests bank-detail change before payment.
cases.procurement_role: Validate supplier relationship context; do not bypass payment controls.
Support only if receipt/supplier evidence becomes relevant.

cases.problem: Engineering asks if liability clause is acceptable.
cases.procurement_role: Provide commercial context and supplier negotiation interface.
Assess supplier capacity after the requirement is understood.
Support supplier escalation/corrective action and commercial follow-up.

cases.primary_owner: AP for invoice block processing; Procurement if PO/commercial terms are wrong
cases.procurement_role: Resolve PO/negotiated price mismatch where applicable.

strong_principle: Route by the nature of the core problem. Then add Procurement where supplier, commercial or buying-process action is part of the solution.
traps: Anything with a supplier belongs to Procurement.
Anything with money belongs to Procurement.
